questions.prompt: How should the expanded manifest coexist with the schema-1 manifests already used by released consumers?
questions.description: The next version remains a patch release, while schema 1 has a live producer in Ghostty.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Keep schema 1 fully supported and introduce schema 2 for the audited lifecycle; reject only operations that require fields unavailable in schema 1.

options.label: Support schemas 1 and 2
options.description: Preserves 0.0.2 consumers while making the stronger contract explicit. Recommended.

options.label: Extend schema 1 in place
options.description: Avoids a schema number change but weakens the meaning of existing schema-1 documents.

options.label: Require schema 2
options.description: Simplest implementation, but intentionally breaks existing consumers in a patch release.

questions.prompt: What should happen after the forkctl-only implementation and tests pass?
questions.description: The shared release-workflow collection and native build matrix are explicitly deferred.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Prepare and publish 0.0.3 through the existing local crates.io/GitHub release path, while deferring only the new CI workflow and asset matrix.

options.label: Publish 0.0.3 locally
options.description: Use the existing release path; add no workflow or matrix. Recommended if the feature should become consumable now.

options.label: Prepare 0.0.3 only
options.description: Commit and verify the versioned implementation but wait for the workflow collection before publishing.

options.label: Do not bump yet
options.description: Land implementation on main at 0.0.2 and decide release mechanics later.

questions.prompt: What should `forkctl new` leave behind for the operator?
questions.description: The command must keep the final bookkeeping patch last while creating a fully documented downstream patch.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Create and position an empty StGit patch with required trailers, update manifest and generated ledger in the bookkeeping patch, then leave implementation edits to the operator.

options.label: Create documented empty patch
options.description: Establishes identity and audit state before implementation. Recommended.

options.label: Update metadata only
options.description: Do not create the StGit patch until the operator does so manually.

options.label: Defer `new`
options.description: Ship status, verify, rebase, and publish first.

questions.prompt: How should the existing uncommitted 0.1/Zed proposal be handled?
questions.description: It currently conflicts with the forkctl-only patch-release direction and is linked from the README.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Revise it into the authoritative forkctl-only 0.0.3 design, removing the Zed migration and 0.1 release claims while preserving useful sourced research.

options.label: Revise into the 0.0.3 design
options.description: Preserves useful research without keeping a contradictory plan. Recommended.

options.label: Preserve as superseded research
options.description: Keep it with an explicit superseded banner and write a separate implementation plan.

options.label: Discard it
options.description: Remove the proposal and README link; derive the implementation only from the reviewed goal package.
